config.empty_when: have any open positions at the moment

connector.notes: No ATS and no per-posting page: the openings are panels of an Elementor accordion and you apply by mail to hr@insphero.com. A zero without it still fails loudly, which is what catches the regex going stale.

companies.name: Intertek

connector.notes: ORACLE RECRUITING CLOUD, tenant hcog.fa.em2.oraclecloud.com. The sites are REGIONAL and intertek.com/careers links them one per country: CX_1 United States 282, CX_2 Canada 26, CX_1003 United Kingdom 26, CX_4001 Bangladesh 0, and CX_2001 the global superset, 374 = the sum of all of them. CX_2001 plus a country filter is therefore the whole employer in one connector. Two traps: siteNumber DOES NOT VALIDATE - CX_9999 returns the tenant default (the same 374) rather than an error, so a typo is invisible and only the titles prove the site - and the site URL's location= filter needs a locationId the API never exposes, which is why the country is matched on each row's PrimaryLocationCountry. On 2026-09-05: US 282, GB 26, CA 26, IN 24, TR 10, ID 4, AU 2 and CH 0 - their country menu does not list Switzerland at all, so this is connected and silent until they post here. 2026-09-16: live, 392 requisitions, 0 in Switzerland (US 290, GB 31, CA 27, IN 25, TR 13, ID 4, AU 2). TRAP: siteNumber does NOT discriminate - CX_9999, an invented site, returns the same 392 as CX_2001, so a working siteNumber proves nothing. The country filter is applied on PrimaryLocationCountry by the adapter, which is what makes the 0 real.
